tagline: A capability layer for STRK20 pool activity: prove something about a wallet's public deposit history, redeem a one-time, value-bearing capability from any wallet.

transactions.description: Deploy Prova's operating account (OpenZeppelin single-signer, no guardian) on Starknet mainnet.
Declare the ProvaPass Cairo contract class on Starknet mainnet.
Deploy the ProvaPass contract instance on Starknet mainnet.
Create 'STRK Loyalty Drop' (predicate: held_since — deposited >= 1 STRK cumulatively, at least 7 days ago).
Claim a Prova Pass from a wallet unrelated to the one that satisfied the predicate, consuming the nullifier one-time on-chain.

Create 'STRK Holder Badge' (predicate: balance_threshold — deposited >= 1 STRK cumulatively, ever, checked against public Deposit events). Second live campaign, proving the platform is multi-predicate, not single-purpose.
Create 'Active Depositor' (predicate: deposit_count — >= 1 deposit into the pool). Third live campaign, a distinct activity-based predicate type.
Fund the deployed ProvaPass contract with 1 real STRK from the operating account, so it can actually pay out reward_amount on claim, not just record a claim.

Create 'STRK Welcome Reward' (predicate: balance_threshold, claim_kind: reward_token — deposited >= 1 STRK cumulatively, ever; redeem pays 0.05 real STRK). Fourth live campaign: proof that redeeming a Prova Pass can move real value, not just record a claim.

Redeem a 'STRK Welcome Reward' pass to a brand-new, never-before-used address. Verified via balanceOf: the recipient's STRK balance went from exactly 0 to exactly 50000000000000000 wei (0.05 STRK) in this transaction, alongside the usual nullifier consumption. Operator-attested for verification (see STATUS.md); the reward-payout mechanism itself (IERC20.transfer in claim_with_prova_pass) is live for any real user going through /api/pass and /api/claim.

_transactions_note: The 10 entries above are all against ProvaPass, the capability-layer contract this project built on top of the pool's public deposit history — none of them are calls into the STRK20 pool contract itself. The single entry below, in strk20_pool_transactions, is different in kind: it is a real, direct interaction with the live STRK20 pool contract at 0x040337b1af3c663e86e333bab5a4b28da8d4652a15a69beee2b677776ffe812a, verified on-chain by this repo's own tooling (scripts/mainnet-admin.mjs tx-status), not merely asserted.

strk20_pool_transactions.description: A real 'enable private tokens' (viewing-key registration + shield) mainnet transaction against the live STRK20 privacy pool contract itself, completed by the team through a privacy-enabled wallet (the Wallet API route documented in the hackathon repo's docs/MAINNET-DAY-0.md, distinct from the app-holds-its-own-prover-key route this project's own attempts confirmed is blocked). Verified independently via this repo's own tx-status diagnostic (scripts/mainnet-admin.mjs), not taken on the submitted hash's word: finality ACCEPTED_ON_L1, execution SUCCEEDED, and the pool contract's own address as the emitter of ViewingKeySet, Deposit (10 STRK, matching a documented real-world reference shield of the same size), and EncNoteCreated in one call. This is the project's one real, direct pool-touching transaction — separate from, and in addition to, the 10 ProvaPass transactions above.

features.destination_binding: A pass can optionally be locked to one destination wallet at issuance (bound_recipient), instead of the default pure-bearer model. /api/claim rejects any other recipient with 403 before the attester ever signs. Additive, opt-in, does not change the unlocked path.
features.client_side_verification: The app independently verifies claims from the browser's own public RPC connection, not through Provah's backend: is_nullifier_consumed read directly on ProvaPass after a claim, and STRK balanceOf diffed before/after for reward campaigns to show the exact payout observed on mainnet.
features.client_side_eligibility_self_check: Eligibility is independently re-derived client-side, from the same public Deposit events Prova's server reads, the moment a wallet connects and before /api/pass is ever called. Same predicate logic (src/lib/predicate.ts ported to ProvaApp.tsx), run in the browser against public RPC, so the server's yes/no verdict is reproducible by anyone, not just asserted.
features.issuance_hygiene: prova_passes.address_commitment = pedersen(address, campaignId), no salt, unique per (campaign_id, address_commitment). /api/pass now rejects a second pass request for a wallet that already holds one for that campaign (409), closing a prior gap where varying the client-supplied salt could mint unlimited passes to one wallet.
features.bounded_reward_exposure: Reward campaign cards show the ProvaPass contract's live STRK balance, read client-side from public RPC. Since claim_with_prova_pass can never pay out more than the contract holds, this is a real, on-chain-verifiable upper bound on what a dishonest attestation could ever cost, not an assertion.
features.defensive_expiry_check: /api/claim now rejects an expired pass (410) before relaying a transaction, instead of relying solely on the Cairo contract's own on-chain expiry assert (prova_pass.cairo) and burning gas on a guaranteed revert.
